title.rendered: Planet Expands Its Flavour Family with the Introduction of Planet Berries

content.rendered:
Planet has added a new taste to its lineup with the launch of Planet Berries, a bright, berry-flavoured carbonated soft drink now available in a 35cl PET bottle. Planet Berries joins Orange, Cocktail and Apple to bring the range to four flavours, giving consumers a fresh new choice for the moments they share.

Guided by its promise of “A World of Tastes,” Planet continues to create beverages built around variety, quality and refreshment.Planet Berries brings a sweet, fruity-flavoured taste to the family, offering a new way to enjoy the everyday gatherings and celebrations the brand is known for.

Speaking on the launch, Naji Awada,Marketing Manager at Planet Bottling Company said, “Every flavour we add to the Planet family gives people one more reason to come together. Berries brings something bright and new to the range, and it carries the same spirit Planet has always stood for. We are confident it will find its place in the moments that matter most to our consumers.”

Planet Berries is available now in supermarkets near you.

About Planet

Planet is a refreshing beverage brand produced in Nigeria by Planet Bottling Company, created to bring people together through shared moments of joy, colour, and flavour. From family celebrations to everyday connections, Planet exists to make every gathering a little brighter, one sip at a time. Planet Bottling Company also produces American Cola, Reaktor and Bubble Up.
